title: Axon Control Plane — region mask policy
description: Masks are a DERIVED VIEW, never canonical state (arch §2.4, §5.5, §10.F). PUT is two-step: first PUT returns a proposed state with a confirm_token; a second PUT with confirm_token + confirmed=true applies via HeartHost.set_region_mask_policy and advances mask revision -> new view_id. Never mutates on first touch.

tail_percent.description: Newest-suffix slider (operational control). Required iff kind=tail_percent.

view_id.description: derive_view_id(masks); the frozen-tick view this mask state produces.

policies.description: Region id -> mask policy. All 13 canonical regions present; identity is always {kind: all} (IDENTITY_MASK_POLICY).

confirm_token.description: From a prior proposal response. Required when confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: Must be true (with confirm_token) for the change to apply. confirm semantics are mandatory.

applied.description: false for a proposal (first touch); true only after a confirmed second PUT.

confirm_token.description: Present on a proposal; single-use, short-lived.

proposed.description: The proposed (unapplied) or resulting (applied) mask state, including the new view_id and revision.
